scope: Public static report and interactive companions; scientific conclusions unchanged.

integrity.checks: Local links and anchors, noindex, timestamp/shape alignment, finite LFP and TF support, phase bounds, source figure hashes, absence of private paths.

exercised: Synchronized image cursor and plot zoom
Power, phase consistency, and image spectra
Animal, individual session and paired-shank selections
Correct session-specific default RF and LFP contact
Saved links to removed Logan session migrate to new Logan session

visual_review: Report figures and all 12 example views reviewed as rendered screenshots; detailed inspection of report opening, paper pairs, desktop fixation traces, three cohort measurements, and mobile layouts. Missing cohort axis labels were found and fixed. Missing RF maps remain explicitly labeled. No scientific values or waveform shapes were modified for appearance.

numerical_check.description: Fresh native-loader clips in both animals and session maps compared to exported arrays with rtol=6e-7, atol=6e-7 and equal missing-value masks. Differences are transport rounding to seven significant digits. Errors below are absolute in the displayed native units (time in ms, voltage in µV, eye velocity in arcmin/s, phase in radians).

limits: Saved clips are a duration-stratified illustrative subset, not prevalence estimates.
Common-contact phase colors are descriptive, not phase-locking tests.
Public presentation checks do not constitute new biological validation.
Publication on GitHub Pages occurs when the branch is merged into its configured main source.

spike_sources.Logan_2020-01-07: original OSP sorting, matching the RF archive

fixation_update.browser_checks: All 12 examples, RF loading, reference/contact/taper/phase controls, session defaults even with old URL parameters, and migration from the removed Logan session; no JavaScript exceptions.
fixation_update.visual_review: Reviewed all six new Logan plots and the replacement Allen plot at desktop display size, including scene and RF panels, traces, spikes, spectra and envelopes. Original unchanged Allen examples retain their prior review.
fixation_update.limitations: RF clarity is illustrative and does not establish single-unit isolation. Original OSP quality labels marked unsorted are retained. The 30-session LFP summaries and written report examples are unchanged.

eye_position_update.estimator: Recorded native-clock position; mean subtraction per window, same DPSS estimators and output time grid as velocity; horizontal and vertical powers added in linear units before dB.
eye_position_update.scientific_tests: 9 native spectral tests passed, including anti-phase H/V power conservation, constant-position-offset invariance, finite-difference velocity gain, missing-axis masking, agreement with SciPy periodograms, timing, gaps, and Nyquist limits.
eye_position_update.export_checks: All 72 position files pass dimensions, shared LFP output time grid, valid-window masks, nonnegative power and RMS-squared consistency. Fresh native clips from both animals match exported position spectra, band power, RMS, support, background, and masks within seven-significant-digit rounding. Existing LFP, velocity, spike and phase values retain regression agreement.
eye_position_update.browser_checks: Position/velocity switching, unchanged LFP/spikes/time, all six window/taper presets in both animals, relative/absolute scale, RMS/power units, fixation navigation, session change and URL reload; zero JavaScript exceptions. Mobile controls fit at 390 px width.
eye_position_update.visual_review: Position and velocity comparisons in both animals inspected at 1480 × 1650; relative position maps and band curves also inspected. Units, shared time alignment, LFP visibility and mobile selector layout checked.
eye_position_update.limits: A display option, not a coupling test. Combined H+V power discards direction. Windows can include saccades; position windows have only their constant mean removed.
